t: A free tool for writing interactive stories that publish to HTML.
steps: Open the Twine browser version or download the desktop app from GitHub releases.
Ask IT for help with the desktop install on school computers.
Pick a story format such as Harlowe, SugarCube, Snowman, or Chapbook.
Create a short story with three linked passages.
Publish the story to an HTML file.
Open the HTML file in another browser to test it.
Save story files to a school folder.
